# Seeds whose SELF-HOST wasm result through the AST lowering
# disagrees with the interpreter's, for TestDifferential_SelfHostWasm
# (internal/e2e/diff_oracle_selfhost_wasm_leg_test.go).
#
# Format: <seed> <reason + issue>. Blank lines and # comments ignored.
#
# Same contract as the four files beside it: a row is a known bug being
# tolerated so the rest of the corpus keeps running, and the leg fails on a new
# divergence and on a listed seed that starts agreeing.
#
# A seed whose oracle byte is 126 or more never reaches this file. WASI refuses
# an exit status outside [0..126), so the leg cannot read that program's answer
# at all and does not compare it — it asserts only that the module neither
# traps nor is rejected. A row here would be claiming a wrong answer nobody
# measured.
